description: This Kotlin source file provides a test implementation of the UserDataRepository interface. It enables manipulation and testing of user data states such as followed topics, bookmarked news resources, viewed news, theme preferences, and onboarding visibility, primarily for testing purposes in an Android application.

classes.name: TestUserDataRepository
classes.description: A test implementation of UserDataRepository that manages user data state in memory using a MutableSharedFlow, allowing tests to simulate user interactions and state changes.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Sets the entire set of followed topic IDs for testing.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Adds or removes a specific topic ID from the followed topics set.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Marks a news resource as bookmarked or not bookmarked.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed or not viewed.

methods.name: setDynamicColorPreference
methods.description: Sets the preference for dynamic color usage.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Sets whether onboarding should be hidden.

methods.name: setUserData
methods.description: Test-only method to directly set user data state.
